question: One liquid contains 20% of acid the other liquid contain 30% of acid. A can is filled with 7 parts of the first liquid and 3 parts of the second liquid. The percentage of the acid in the new mixture is:
solution:
**Given:**

One liquid contains 20% of acid the other liquid contain 30% of acid.

A can is filled with 7 parts of the first liquid and 3 parts of the second liquid.

**Calculation:**

The percentage of the acid in the new mixture is:

⇒ (20 × 7 + 30 × 3) / 10

⇒ 230 / 10 = 23%

**∴ The correct option is** **4**
